notApplicable.size: Preview has no public component size; action buttons choose their own compact toolbar size.
notApplicable.disabled: Preview does not expose a disabled state.
notApplicable.pressed: Action button press feedback is verified in Button; Preview verifies source expansion and action callbacks.
notApplicable.densityNames: The demo maps ConfigProvider compact/standard/comfortable to public Preview compact/regular/spacious; these are independent protocols.
